column2: Emerald Masks are the highest class of monster hunter within the Order of St. George, and require the most training. They are the dragon hunters, following in the steps of the Founder of the Order, St. George. There are two ways to earn an Emerald Mask: one requires being chosen to train as a Silver Mask, rising to the status of Master at that rank, and then undergoing years of training at the Great House of St. George; the other requires finding and killing a dragon in the wild. Dragons are born from mankind's most primal and powerful emotions, and most form in societies with a deep cultural belief in dragons. There are few dragons left in the world today, and even fewer Emerald Masks.
